name: Chili Sin Carne
steps: Bring the water with the stock powder to a boil. Pour it over the soy granules and let them soak for 10 minutes until they have swollen.
Dice the onion and the garlic and sauté them in the olive oil until translucent.
Add the soaked soy granules, the drained kidney beans, the chopped tomatoes and the chili powder. Simmer for 20 minutes.
